verdict.rationale: BigCommerce is an ecommerce platform, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows no assistant inside the store control panel that users can hand tasks to. The only AI mentions are 'AI-powered search and chat' and 'AI-ready page actions' on the developer documentation site, plus an llms.txt file for external agents. Both are adjacent features that do not let users delegate tasks to the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
